# FQ-GLEASON-D2-RATIONAL-PLANE-OBSTRUCTION

The actual binaryRay tests the sign of xy and treats the x-axis as value one. Fresh Lean compilation rechecks scale invariance, all nonzero rational orthogonal frames, and no quadratic representation. Native records retain the four-point fitting obstruction: axes fix a=1,c=0; (1,1) fixes b=1/2; (1,2) gives 3 versus5. This is d=2 over Q and supplies no d≥3 result.

The source rational-plane binary frame function is universally scale-invariant, additive on nonzero orthogonal frames, and has no quadratic representation; the concrete fitting residual is reproduced exactly.

Remaining: No extension to dimension at least three, arbitrary real frames or a universal Gleason reconstruction is supplied. A complete refined-carrier operad remains open.
